item.createfueltank.fuel_tank.tooltip.su: A _Fluid Tank_ that keeps any _Diesel Engine_ or liquid _Thruster_ touching it topped up with fuel by itself. No pipes or pumps needed.
item.createfueltank.fuel_tank.tooltip.be: Stops feeding. Fluid stays inside the tank.
item.createfueltank.long_fuel_tank.toolt: A _Fuel Tank_ lying on its side. Chains end to end along the ground, up to 8 blocks long, for thin airframes.
Stops feeding. Fluid stays inside the tank.
